verdict.rationale: Unstructured documents a no-code workflow designer UI whose Partitioner node lets you pick a partition strategy without code. That suggests results can be configured in a browser before programming. But the quickstarts that promise structured JSON in about 5 minutes rely on a Python script or Claude prompts, not a web upload. Missing for 10: evidence of a drag-and-drop or upload playground, an in-browser preview of parse/extract output for a single document, and independent hands-on confirmation of a no-code try-before-you-code flow.
